story.title: The Hourglass Tenant
story.logline: A woman discovers her landlord is charging her rent not in money, but in physical years of her life.
story.twist: She isn't paying to live in the apartment; she's paying to keep the landlord from aging.
story.ending: Who is rattling your front door right now, collecting tonight's rent?

scenes.narration: My apartment costs twenty years of my life every single month, yet I pay it with a smile.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close up of 25-year-old Maya with messy brown hair and a grey hoodie, standing in a dimly lit Victorian apartment hallway, looking exhausted.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up pushing back rapidly to reveal the hallway.

scenes.narration: Landlord Arthur says rent is due at midnight sharp. He holds a brass hourglass filled with glowing white sand.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya in the same grey hoodie inside her cluttered apartment, watching an elderly man in a sharp black suit holding an ornate brass hourglass.
scenes.camera: Medium shot tracking slowly left to right.

scenes.narration: I press my palm against the glass. The glowing sand drains upward, stealing my youth to balance the ledger.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya in her grey hoodie pressing her bare hand against the glowing glass of the hourglass, wincing as her fingers turn slightly wrinkled.
scenes.camera: Close-up on hands and the hourglass.

scenes.narration: My reflection in the hall mirror shows silver strands in my hair. I am aging backward in reverse.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya in the grey hoodie staring into a cracked hallway mirror, noticing new grey streaks in her messy brown hair.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot looking at the mirror reflection.

scenes.narration: Arthur pockets the full hourglass, tipping his hat as his own deep facial wrinkles miraculously smooth away.
scenes.visual_prompt: Arthur in his black suit looking noticeably younger, smiling sharply while 25-year-old Maya watches him from her apartment doorway in her grey hoodie.

scenes.narration: I used to think this city was expensive. Then I realized time is the only currency they actually want.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya in her grey hoodie sitting alone on her worn-out velvet sofa, staring blankly at the empty brass stand on her coffee table.
scenes.camera: Medium profile shot drifting slowly forward.

scenes.narration: Tonight, the hourglass is empty before midnight. Arthur bangs on my door, demanding the balance I do not have.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya in her grey hoodie standing terrified inside her apartment as heavy pounding echoes on the wooden front door.
scenes.camera: Handheld camera shaking slightly to match the pounding.

scenes.narration: I open the door to run, but Arthur grabs my wrist. He doesn't want my years anymore.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya in her grey hoodie struggling as a much younger, vigorous Arthur grabs her wrist firmly in the doorway.
scenes.camera: Low angle close-up on their locked hands.

scenes.narration: He whispers that this building isn't a rental. It's a farm, and my lease was up an hour ago.
scenes.visual_prompt: Arthur whispering sinisterly into terrified 25-year-old Maya's ear in the doorway, the hallway lights flickering out completely.

scenes.narration: My apartment costs twenty years of my life every single month. Who is rattling your front door right now?
scenes.visual_prompt: Pitch black screen with only a faint glow of a brass hourglass ticking in the distance.
scenes.camera: Static extreme wide shot into total darkness.

caption.title: The Hourglass Tenant
caption.caption:
She thought the strange lease only cost her money. Every month, a little more gray in her hair, a little less spring in her step—until she realized the truth. What would you give to secure your dream home?

Would you trade your youth to stay?
